predictedBugs: A legacy oauth.completed receipt could still win if the proof reader selected a guided receipt without checking that it is the latest completion.
A degraded persisted Mailchimp row could remain impossible to disconnect if generic mutation gating treated degraded as unverifiable for every action.
Omnix could leak scope-pending or degraded through the answer-item value even while the detail text remained calm.
edgeCases: The latest Mailchimp completion is a legacy arbitrary receipt after an older valid guided completion; authority must fail closed.
The OAuth transaction actor was once owner but that membership is now revoked; evidence must no longer be current.
A support or assistant viewer reads safe status; the proof may be viewed but no reconnect, retry or disconnect control may render.
A degraded connection has no connection ID; recovery and disconnect controls must remain hidden.
